privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Photos are analysed in memory and never stored on the server.
privacy.p2: Location is optional and rounded to ~1 km before storage; precise coordinates are never logged.
privacy.p3: No audio is recorded without consent. Demo data can be fully reset at any time.
about.title: Impact & about
about.p1: Artisanal fishing feeds Mauritius, but catch records are still paper-based and marine information is scattered.
about.p2: Lamer Konekte gives fishers a Morisyen-first assistant: photograph the catch, confirm the species, record honest measurements, check sourced rules, and prepare declarations — even offline.
about.team: Team Ctrl200 — Gemma 4 hackathon, Multimodal Track, Blue Economy pillar.
limitation.permanent: Lamer Konekte provides AI-assisted catch documentation and informational guidance. Species suggestions and regulatory checks must be confirmed against official sources and by the fisher or an authorised officer.
marine.disclaimer: Marine forecasts are informational and may be incomplete near the coast. Confirm conditions through official local marine advisories before travelling.
